query: I am looking for bluetooth earbuds that fit comfortably and have a charging case. I want them to be easy to connect to Bluetooth and have fantastic sound quality. It's important that they have a built-in microphone for calls. I don't mind if they have additional functions, as long as I can listen to audio and have clear calls.
review: These are great bluetooth earbuds! Pleasantly surprised. These fit my ears and are comfortable. I love the charging case. They are easy to connect to the Bluetooth and the sound is fantastic. I've been just using the right ear one for the most part and when calls come in they can hear me and I can hear them. I haven't figured out the tapping for different functions but my life is still good and I don't really care as long as I can listen to what I'm watching and hear in calls. Happy with my purchase!
persona: 운동할 때 선 없는 인이어 이어폰을 쓰려고 해요, 땀이나 비에 좀 강했으면 좋겠어요.
귀에 잘 맞고 편안한 걸 선호하고, 휴대용 충전 케이스가 꼭 필요합니다.

액티브 노이즈 캔슬링은 별로 필요 없고, 음질이 좋으면 만족합니다.
가격은 2만 원 안쪽으로 생각하고 있어요.
opening: 운동용으로 쓸 무선 이어폰 찾고 있어요.
brief: 운동할 때 쓸 편안한 인이어 무선 이어폰을 찾는 사용자 — 충전 케이스, 쉬운 블루투스 연결, 좋은 음질과 통화용 마이크를 원함, 가격은 2만 원 안쪽.

query: I am a runner looking for earbuds that have a snug fit and don't easily come loose while I'm running. I also want them to have clear and loud sound. I've had issues with earbuds bouncing out in the past and constantly having to readjust them is very annoying. I used the largest inserts to make sure they stay in place. I highly recommend earbuds like these.
review: Outstanding - best I've had. As a runner I was looking for a snug fit that didn't bounce loose, and also something loud and clear. Far too many earbuds bounce out and there's nothing more annoying than to keep pressing them back in. These stay put (I used the largest of the inserts) and they are very loud. Highly recommend!
persona: 달리기하면서 착용해도 빠지지 않는 꽉 끼는 이어폰을 선호한다.
선 없는 무선 이어폰이 좋고, 인이어 타입으로 귀에 밀착되는 착용감을 원한다.
음량이 크고 소리가 또렷해야 하며 마이크와 방수·방진 기능이 꼭 필요하다.
액티브 노이즈 캔슬링은 불필요하고, 가격대는 6만 원 안쪽을 염두에 두고 있다.
opening: 달릴 때 귀에서 튀어나오지 않는 이어폰 찾고 있어.
brief: 러닝 중에도 흘러내리지 않고 소리가 크고 선명하며 마이크와 방수 기능이 있는 무선 인이어를 찾는 러너 역할.

query: I am looking for a wireless headset for my laptop for work. I want something that is very comfortable to wear and has good reviews. It should fit well and have clear sound quality, so that people can hear me well. It would be great if I don't have to turn up the volume all the way to hear and be heard. I am not looking for an expensive Bluetooth headset, but something that does the job well at a lower cost.
review: Very Comfortable I was looking for a wireless headset for my laptop to use for work and I found this one!! The reviews were awesome and they did not let me down. The headset fits comfortably and at first I was afraid it sounded low and people could not hear me but my claimants have assured me they hear me well!! It’s nice to have a headset that I don’t need to have on full blast to hear and be heard. There are more expensive Bluetooth headsets but this one does the job well at a fraction of the cost. Thank you!!
persona: 노트북으로 재택근무할 때 주로 쓰려는 사람이라 하루 종일 착용해도 편안한 걸 찾고 있다.
무선이라 선 없이 쓰는 걸 선호하고, 온이어 타입이라 귀에 잘 맞는 착용감을 원한다.
마이크가 달려 있어 상대방이 내 목소리를 또렷하게 들을 수 있어야 하고, 볼륨을 최대치로 올리지 않아도 들리고 들려야 한다.
리뷰 평이 좋고 가성비 좋은 제품을 선호해 비싼 블루투스 헤드셋 대신 6만 원 안쪽의 합리적 가격대를 원한다.
opening: 노트북에서 쓸 무선 헤드셋 찾고 있어.
brief: 재택근무용으로 편안하고 통화 음질이 또렷한, 가성비 좋은 온이어 무선 헤드셋을 찾는 상황.

query: I need a pair of affordable over-the-head Bluetooth headphones that are of good quality. They should be simple and suitable for use at the gym.
review: You get what you pay for these are actually great! i’m shocked at how little they cost for what you get. there no beats by dre but they are very good quality and just nice and simple for the gym! highly recommend if you need a good over the head pair of blue tooth headphones that don’t cost a arm and a leg.
persona: 운동할 때 간단히 쓰려고 무선 오버이어 헤드폰을 원해요.
가격은 3만 원 안쪽으로 부담 없는 제품을 선호해요.

opening: 운동할 때 쓸 무선 오버이어 헤드폰 찾고 있어.

query: I'm looking for wireless earbuds with a great sound quality and a stylish color. I want them to be lightweight and easy to carry around, especially when I go to the gym or on walks. It would be amazing if they have a long battery life because I don't want to keep charging them frequently. However, I'm slightly concerned about the on and off button as it seems a bit difficult to use. I hope I'll be able to figure it out with some practice.
review: Love the color. love the sound. these are awesome. Theyre very lightweight, easy to carry with you. Sound quality is super duper good, as expected with any Marshall Brand product. I charged them completely the first day I got them and Haven’t charged them since( not kidding these are awesome). Its been like 2 weeks since.  I use them pretty often too like to the gym or on walks or just when im cleaning at home. My phone says the battery is still at 50 some % so thats awesome. Anyway. only complaint is the on and off button, Its a knob that you have to hold down for a few seconds but I always have trouble with turning them off or on. I hold it down and it just wont work so I have to try it a few times to get them to turn off/on. Maybe I just havent gotten the hand of it yet.
persona: 선 없는 제품을 선호해서 무선으로 착용감 가볍고 휴대하기 쉬운 제품을 원해요.
온이어 타입 헤드폰을 선호하고, 일상에서 특히 헬스장이나 산책할 때 주로 쓰려고 해요.
색상이 스타일리시한 제품을 좋아하고 소리 품질이 좋아야 만족해요.
배터리 지속시간이 길어 자주 충전하지 않아도 되는 제품을 원해요(예산은 15만 원대).
노이즈 캔슬링은 필요 없고, 전원 온·오프가 직관적이면 좋겠지만 버튼이 약간 불편해도 연습하면 괜찮을 것 같아요.
opening: 헬스장이나 산책할 때 쓸 무선 온이어 헤드폰 찾고 있어.
brief: 헬스장·산책·집안일 등 일상에서 가볍게 쓰면서 색상과 음질, 긴 배터리 지속시간을 중시하는 사용자를 연기한다.

query: I need headphones that are great for running and will stay in my ears. They should be lightweight and barely noticeable when I wear them. It would be convenient if they are also easy to carry around and durable. A good battery life is important too, since I often forget to turn them off. I don't expect them to be noise-canceling, but I'm interested in trying out a conduction headset.
review: Great headphones for running No earphones ever stay in my ears, so I was looking for a solution for that while I run. These fit the bill perfectly. They are light and I barely feel them.  They fit easily in my purse/pocket (they've taken some abuse and keep working). The battery life is also very good. I do forget to turn them off often and it keeps on going. I've never used a conduction headset before, and I'am very pleased. Do not expect it to be noise canceling - that is not what this is for!
persona: 조깅할 때 쓸 가벼운 무선 헤드셋을 찾고 있습니다. 귀에서 흘러내리는 게 너무 싫어서 착용감이 확실한 제품을 원합니다. 골전도 타입을 직접 써보고 싶고, 소음 차단 기능은 별로 중요하지 않습니다. 주머니나 가방에 넣고 다니기 쉬운 작고 튼튼한 제품을 선호합니다. 마이크가 있고 땀·물에 강한 방수·방진 성능과 배터리 지속력이 좋은 제품이면 좋겠습니다. 가격대는 5만 원 안팎까지 생각하고 있습니다.
opening: 러닝할 때 흘러내리지 않는, 가볍고 휴대하기 편한 이어폰 찾고 있어요.
brief: 조깅용으로 귀에 잘 고정되고 가볍고 방수·마이크·긴 배터리 가진 무선 골전도 타입을 원함

query: I'm looking for comfortable and high-quality headphones with an attractive design. I have small ears, so it's important that they stay in place and are comfortable to use. I also want headphones that have good sound quality and come with a charging case. Price is also a factor for me, so I'm looking for a great deal. Overall, I want to be a happy customer.
review: Attractive, comfortable & great quality! First for the asthetics....these look and feel great! I bought the rose pink color and really love it. I have small inner ears so finding a headphone that will stay in and is comfortable to use has been a challenge. I am happy to say that these feel great and the sound is great too! I am a late bloomer when it comes to using Bluetooth so I am impressed by the charging case. It was easy to sync with my phone and the price paid for these headphone was a really great deal. Good sound quality, lightweight  and attractive...very happy customer!

query: I need a comfortable headset with flawless connectivity, great sound quality, and clear audio on both ends of the call. It should be reasonably priced compared to similar models found in truck stops. I would highly recommend this Bluetooth headset for anyone who drives.
review: Just what I was looking for This headset is comfortable, the connectivity is flawless, sound quality is great and the people I’ve talked to when connected say it’s loud and clear on their end. The value for the price is unbeatable compared to similar models you see in the truck stops. Would definitely recommend this model to anyone that drives and is looking for a Bluetooth headset. Two thumbs up!

query: I want to find wireless earbuds that exceed the quality of AirPods but are more affordable. They should have excellent sound quality and effective noise cancellation. I also need a microphone that performs well during phone calls. It's okay if they don't connect instantly to my iPhone and if there is a slight delay when removing an earbud. I'm looking for earbuds with a durable case that can be charged once a week. Although the case may be lighter and cheaper than AirPods, it's fine as long as it protects the earbuds. I prefer the sleek black color, but it would be great if there were other case color options available to help me locate them easily in my bag.
review: Surpasses AirPods in quality and price Couldn’t be happier for the money. Half the price of a standard airpod with better sound quality by far and very noise canceling. I’ve been told that the mic is no question better for my phone calls as well. It doesn’t connect as instantly to my iPhone but that’s not surprising. There is also a bit of a delay when I remove and earbud from my ear and the pause of my music. That’s expected though for non apple products and apple compatibility. I charge the case about once a week and I use them probably 1-3 hours a day. The case is a little cheaper and lighter than the AirPods’, but people smash their AirPods all the time even with a more durable case, at least these I can afford to replace as needed. The black is sleek and the lights on the buds are nifty, but I wish there was a case colorway option. The black is hard to find in my bag, which is just a personal thing.
persona: 출퇴근이나 운동하면서 선 없는 인이어 이어버드를 쓰는 걸 선호해요.

주 사용 용도는 운동용이라 착용이 안정적이고 활동 중에도 쉽게 빠지지 않는 제품을 원해요.
opening: 에어팟보다 음질 좋고 노캔 잘되는 무선 이어버드 찾고 있어요.
brief: 운동하면서 하루 1–3시간 쓰는 사람 연기: 무선 인이어, 강력한 ANC, 통화용 마이크 우수, 케이스는 가볍고 일주일 충전 유지되면 OK.
